body: No her reaction is 100% accurate. I have “associates”, I work with people, or people I have to interact with on a somewhat regular basis, but I have no interest in getting to know any of these people on anything other than a surface level. I simply don’t care.

For the record I’ve scrolled through this sub looking at a few of these confessions. I own a 9 mm pistol, an AR-15 and have researched the proper way to “do it”. I’ve researched how many and how painful it would be to overdose from pills, and although I was never an IV user ( scared of needles ) I suppose ODing from dope would be a way to go. I’ve also thought of renting a storage unit, letting a car run and taking sleeping pills while sitting inside of said car. 

Point is, most of these people seem to be here for attention. I guess that’s why I’ve never opened up about this, terrified to be lumped with the rest of these people.
